exact_blockers: No active ChatGPT hybrid worker has yet persisted and exact-readback-verified a result for any of the 12 durable GitHub requests.
Microstructure scheduled probes produced no matching hybrid result; the task runtime previously disabled that worker after runs, requiring repair/re-enable.
A one-time scheduled GitHub-access canary did not start by more than two minutes after its exact due time; therefore connector invocation inside scheduled ChatGPT execution could not be tested.

The automations control surface exposes task state and last_run_time but no detailed per-run tool/error log, so the precise internal scheduled-worker failure cannot be proven from the available task controls.
